sentences.text: Anarthraspis was an extinct genus of arthrodire placoderm fish that lived during the Early Devonian period.
This animal belongs to the class Placodermi, a group known for their bony armor.
The type species Anarthraspis chamberlini lived at the same time as the placoderm Bryantolepis.
The two species of Anarthraspis were described in 1932 and assigned to the genus in 1934, with fossils found in the Beartooth Butte Formation of Wyoming and Montana, USA.
The species name chamberlini honors British Prime Minister Neville Chamberlain.
The parent group of Anarthraspis is the family Actinolepididae.
Anarthraspis lived between 410.62 and 393.47 million years ago during the Emsian stage.
